performance_case.causal_mechanism: A complete UTC-day BTC move of at least 3 percent may identify a persistent volatility state in which the next complete day's RV24 remains elevated relative to the exact pre-shock 20-day median, independently of whether price itself continues or reverses. This slice implements only the preregistered point-in-time measurement and terminal evidence machinery needed to test that mechanism on future same-leaf observations.
performance_case.claim_boundary: A positive V2 source result proves only that exactly four offline repository paths implement the accepted, dormant-until-activation, research-only forward volatility-persistence diagnostic under the corrected non-circular source identity contract, with closed schema, exact D-21 through D+1 evidence binding, frozen formulas and gates, immutable snapshots, one existing-heartbeat child and synthetic validation. It proves no deployment or activation receipt, forward episode, prediction, causality, statistical significance, strategy mapping, risk budget, fee-adjusted PnL, drawdown, capacity, candidate, OOS or Trading value and authorizes only Manager review and commit of unchanged bytes.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: Immediate drawdown effect is zero. If later untouched forward evidence retains the volatility-state mechanism, a separately preregistered equal-capital experiment may test whether participation or sizing control reduces drawdown without discarding positive convexity; no such mapping or economic claim exists in this implementation.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: Implementing the frozen evaluator before outcomes arrive prevents outcome-aware code and gate selection and lets the existing daily source accumulate an auditable second mechanism without another timer or writer. The cost is four reviewed files, dormant activation plumbing, at least 23 same-leaf days for one episode and at least 12 qualifying shocks before a positive diagnostic decision.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: The implementation has zero immediate fee-adjusted total PnL effect. Its capability value is lower learning latency and stronger evidence integrity for one pre-registered volatility-state mechanism; all matched-capital performance testing remains a later separate experiment.
